title: A negative support diagnostic does not establish a quasiconvex failure
statement: Producer reports fixed-family tangent search found no separation and approached single-wave limits. Printed incompatible_support_gap=-.016864541969365494 with approximate linear constraints is NUMERICAL ONLY; it provides no positive incompatible-support witness, and even pointwise/non-polyconvex support incompatibility would not alone prove QC failure. Current constrained_pc_probe.py docstring labels pointwise comparator, while prior logged scope says constrained-field attack. Snapshot is stable but not independently matched to executed version, so no stronger executed theorem follows from filename/docstring. Unsuccessful finite search is not equivalence, saturation or no-go for broader fields. Later producer correction explicitly states the pointwise determinant-support probe establishes NO actual gradient law,QCobstruction or polyconvexity conclusion. Dense search exact receipt is CONIC ROC of rational Hessian seeds,not global admission or QC; square-tangent coefficients remain proposals needing separateROC. Updated docstrings exclude inherited __doc__ contamination. Stable versions still not independently identified with each execution. No admitted negative found.
